rules.statement: Section 404 of the Civil Procedure Code allows the court to admit parties as plaintiffs or defendants after affording a hearing to all parties to the action, in the case of assignment, creation or devolution of any interest in the subject matter of a pending action.
rules.supporting_quote: That section gives the Court power to allow the assignee to be added as a party when the assignment was made at any time pending the action; and the Court ought to do so in a proper case when it appears convenient and possible without prejudice to the other party.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 404 of the Civil Procedure Code
